text.k206: Are virtual PBX and cloud PBX the same thing?
text.k207: Yes, they are two names for the same solution. Virtual PBX, cloud PBX and IP PBX all describe a phone system hosted on the internet instead of a physical box inside the company. Some vendors use one term, some the other — the technology is the same. AzuPhone is Azuton's virtual cloud PBX.
text.k208: How does a cloud PBX work?
text.k209: A cloud PBX is a telephony solution fully managed, stored and maintained on the internet through cloud computing, rather than a physical device on site.
text.k211: Cloud telephony, also called VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol), moves your entire business phone network to a cloud system on the internet, with no need to change the premises, since it uses the internet the company already has.
text.k213: PBX (Private Branch Exchange), or PABX (Private Automatic Branch Exchange), is a private telephone network used by a company. Users of a PBX phone system share a number of external lines for making calls.
text.k214: How does a virtual PBX work?
text.k215: An IP PBX or virtual PBX is a complete phone system that carries calls over IP data networks — that is, over the internet. The whole conversation is sent and received as data packets across the network in real time.
text.k216: How does the extension system work?
text.k217: The everyday term “telephone extension” has often been confused with the extension function of a phone. An extension is simply two or more handsets connected on the same telephone line. With a PBX, a single line can carry several cordless extensions (on average, five).
text.k218: Do I need internet to use the service?
text.k219: Yes — but the advantage is that VoIP takes far less bandwidth than conventional telephony. On a traditional 15-minute call, data transmission runs around 10 minutes at 128 kbps, whereas the same call over the cloud takes roughly 5.1 minutes of transmission at 64 kbps.
text.k221: With VoIP your company has internal communication options that connect headquarters with every branch. Any call between extensions is free, and technology providers can include call transfer, call waiting, audio conferencing, voicemail and other services at no extra charge.
text.k223: Because calls are turned into encoded and encrypted data and then transmitted over IP, a cloud call is considered far more secure.
